title: Rubber composition containing polysaccharide
abstract: Disclosed herein are compositions comprising a rubber component and a polysaccharide, wherein the polysaccharide comprises: i) poly alpha-1, 3-glucan; ii) poly alpha-1, 3-1, 6-glucan; iii) a water-insoluble α - (1, 3-glucan) polymer having 90% or more α -1, 3-glycosidic linkages, less than 1% by weight of α -1, 3, 6-glycosidic branching points, and a number average degree of polymerization in the range from 55 to 10,000; iv) dextran; v) a composition comprising a poly alpha-1, 3-glucan ester compound as disclosed herein; or vi) a water-insoluble cellulose having a weight average degree of polymerization (DPw) of from about 10 to about 1000 and a cellulose II crystal structure. These compositions may be used in articles such as tires, belts, seals, footwear, coatings, films, or adhesives.
